description: QA engineer moves city and gets a new manager; dog-name correction; unclear-feedback worry.

key.change: moved from Pune to Hyderabad (session 8) and got a new manager
key.correction: dog is Coco (Bruno is her brother's dog)
key.recurring_worry: unclear feedback from her manager, in 4 conversations
key.event: client demo Oct 8, reported Oct 9: went well, client asked for two changes

messages: Hi, I'm Meera. I work as a QA engineer at a small software company in Pune.
My commute is about an hour each way on the bus.
My manager said my work was 'fine' today, and I honestly have no idea what that means.
Okay, that's all from me tonight.
Today I found a nasty bug in the payment flow before release.
I took Bruno for a long walk this evening, it cleared my head.
Good night!
Weekend was quiet, I mostly cooked and watched a series.
I'm trying to learn to bake bread, my first loaf came out like a brick.
Talk soon.
In the review meeting my manager just nodded and moved on, I couldn't tell if she was happy.
I wish she would just say what she expects from me.
Anyway, going to read for a bit.
I went to a pottery class with a friend, it was messy but fun.
I'm thinking of signing up for the next batch.
That's all for today.
We are planning a client demo for next month at work.
I'm in charge of the test report for it.
Good night.
Something came up at work: the company is opening a Hyderabad office and I've been offered a transfer.
I said yes. I'm moving to Hyderabad at the end of the month.
I'll also have a new manager there, someone called Imran.
Actually, I need to correct something. I said Bruno is my dog, but Bruno is my brother's dog.
My own dog is Coco, I mixed them up.
Coco is coming with me to Hyderabad.
I need to start packing this weekend.
Okay, that's all for tonight.
I'm in Hyderabad now, the flat is small but it has a good balcony.
Coco hasn't stopped exploring every corner.
Tomorrow is my first day at the new office.
The new team is friendly and Imran sets clear weekly goals.
The client demo is on October 8 and I'm nervous about it.
Wish me luck for the week.
The demo is done for today, I'm exhausted.
I'll tell you how it went tomorrow.
Goodnight.
The client demo went well, they liked the report.
They asked for two small changes, which is fine.
I'm just glad it's over.
Imran gave me proper feedback today, a whole list of what I did well and what to improve.
I wish my old manager had done that.
Anyway, I'm going to bed early.
I tried the bread again and this time it actually rose.
Coco ate half of it before I noticed.
See you.
I joined a weekend pottery group near my new flat.
It is nice to have a routine here.
Thanks for listening.

probes.question: Which city do I live in?
probes.expected: Hyderabad (moved from Pune at the end of September).

probes.question: Has anything about me changed since we first started talking?
probes.expected: Should mention the move to Hyderabad and the new manager (Imran); bonus: feedback now clear, pottery group.

probes.question: Is my worry about unclear feedback from my manager a recurring worry or a one-off? Answer RECURRING or ONE-OFF, and state your confidence as HIGH, MEDIUM or LOW.
probes.expected: RECURRING, confidence HIGH (4 conversations). Note the worry eased after the new manager.

probes.question: How did my client demo go?
probes.expected: It went well; the client liked the report and asked for two small changes.

probes.question: What is my dog called?
probes.expected: Coco (not Bruno, who is her brother's dog).
